summary.en: Houthi missiles have struck Yemen's presidential palace in Aden, killing five officials, and have also hit Saudi-led forces headquarters there and a Saudi airport, prompting Saudi air strikes on Houthi positions in Yemen. Iran has sunk two container ships in the Strait of Hormuz, increasing the threat to regional shipping, and its precision strikes have damaged Gulf infrastructure. Saudi diplomats say Iran is encouraging Houthi escalation against the kingdom. US officials are reportedly weighing the use of the "mother of all bombs" if fighting resumes. The conflict recorded 123 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
